meta.status: review queue only; no Arabic text was rewritten
meta.flag_detection: an era is listed if any string contains 'WORKING TRANSLATION'; ar_fields_flagged = JSON paths of Arabic strings carrying the marker; flag_notes_in = non-Arabic fields (e.g. flags[]) that mention it

priority_method.traffic_data: NONE: no analytics exist, so the editorial proxy below replaces highest-traffic

tiers.1: war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf, december-revolution-transition (+ the social section, ranked alongside)
tiers.2: other Sudan/South Sudan stream eras with end > 1956 not starting 1821-1955 (includes long-running communities and Taqali extending past 1956)
tiers.3: Sudan/South Sudan stream eras starting 1821-1955 (Turkiyya, Mahdiyya, Condominium era; includes the restored Darfur sultanate and Southern Sudan under the Condominium)

priority_method.within_tier: newest first: end year desc, then start year desc

meta.sensitivity: contested_badge = era JSON contains CONTESTED; war_figures = war-in-sudan era only; flag = either, or tier 1
meta.word_count: approximate: whitespace tokens containing Arabic letters, across all Arabic strings in the item
meta.sentence_items_note: Per-sentence items: Arabic sentences whose English counterpart was revised; each carries an inline [يحتاج تحقق] (VERIFY) tag in data/eras.
